title: Yoda desktop post-fix 扇出与 active-only hydration 部分验收
description: 在包含修复的 Yoda desktop runtime 上复测周期同步，并把运行时 measurement、代码推导 upper bound、correctness gate 和缺失的用户体验 A/B 分开报告。

items: Yoda v0.18.10 / commit 290fbc48c7 的 patched Electron build
task inventory：916 条总 records，其中 33 条 active
项目规定的完整 format、lint、typecheck、test 与 build 门禁

prompt: 验证周期同步与 active-only hydration 修复：记录 unique Git subprocess，把 hydration 数量只作为 inventory 与代码路径推导的 eligibility 上界，并跑完整门禁；没有正式同负载 inputLatency/RSS A/B 时保持 partially_verified。

items: 8 remotes 的一个 post-fix 周期观察到 15 个 unique Git subprocess
初始 hydration eligibility 的 code-derived upper bound 从全部 916 条 records 收敛到 33 条 active records；这不是 TaskStore telemetry
项目完整门禁通过，test suite 共 3,115 tests；该数字仅为 correctness gate
终态为 partially_verified，并要求补齐同负载 inputLatency、event-loop 与 main/renderer RSS A/B

provenance.sample_window: 600 samples at 100 ms across 8 remote synchronizations; approximately 4 seconds active
provenance.sampler: macOS process inventory filtered to Git descendants
provenance.process_boundary: Git descendants observed during the synchronization cycle

observations.note: Peak concurrency was 5. This runtime count is a measurement, not an acceptance record.

inputs: before code path: initial hydration considered all records
after code path: initial hydration considers active records only
derivation.formula: eligible records = all records before; active records after
assumptions: the recorded inventory matches the mounted project used to inspect the two code paths

comparison.note: The inventory and before/after code paths establish directional eligibility bounds, not paired runtime telemetry; the report must suppress an exact delta.

provenance.observed_at: derived from the 2026-08-09 task inventory and source review
provenance.sampler: runtime database inventory plus before/after hydration call-path review

derived_bounds.note: This is not resident TaskStore telemetry and must not be reported as a measured 916-to-33 store reduction or an exact percentage delta.

verification_gates.note: The count demonstrates regression-gate depth; it is not a runtime performance observation or acceptance.

boundaries: 15 unique Git subprocesses is an after runtime measurement; without a comparable measured baseline it does not yield an exact reduction percentage
916→33 is an active-only hydration implementation bound derived from inventory and code paths, not TaskStore telemetry
3,115 tests is a correctness gate and does not replace live user-experience A/B
Yoda is the first calibration case for platform_family=desktop and runtime=electron; it is not evidence for other platform families
next_measurement: On a stable patched build, replay the same 8-remotes cycle and collect comparable inputLatency, event-loop, and main/renderer RSS before/after windows with the same sampler.
